name: Rs Christmas Santa
author: khorshed Alam

sections.description:
Celebrate the holiday season with our WordPress plugin that includes Santa Pop-Up, festive Music, a Countdown to Christmas, and a Christmas Schedule to keep your site merry and bright.

christmas is an easy-to-use Rs Christmas Santa plugin that can add snow, santa, decorations, music to your WordPress website. All the effects are togglable so you can choose the ones you want.

In order to keep the plugin light weight and high performance. The snow uses CSS3 animation and as such is not compatible with IE9.

Rs Christmas Santa feature:

1.Using santa pop-up and flying this pop-up
2.using music for christmas
3.count-down using by short code any post or pages
4.Set schedule for this item
5.Set count down widget and shotcode 
6.Set random christmas wish text widget
7.you are customize all item
8. and Christmas Schedule select how many days before active this effect

Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

This plugin interacts with an external server to fetch festive music.
https://aptest.therssoftware.com/audio/ is used to host the music files .
When the music feature is enabled, the plugin will request audio files from the server.
Only the audio file name that needs to be downloaded is sent to the server.
sections.installation:
The quickest method for installing the Christmas Plugin is:

  1. Visit Plugins -> Upload Plugin -> Choose File “rs-christmas-santa.zip”
  2. Click “Install Now”
  3. Finally click “Activate Plugin”

This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload rs-christmas-santa unzip folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
